cohort: 30 patients with GDM and 30 healthy pregnant women
finding: The expression of TGFB1, COL1A1 and miR-139-5p is changed in placenta tissue of GDM cases and many genes in the interacting networks of TGFB1 and COL1A1 could contribute to the pathogenicity of GDM.
mod_finding: This study mentions placental tissue being collected during cesarean deliveries but does not examine the relationship between mode of delivery and the study outcomes.
